verses.en: I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
verses.pt: Eu te louvarei, Senhor, de todo o meu coração; contarei todas as tuas maravilhas.
verses.en_web: I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker on Muthlabben. A Psalm. Of David.> I will give you praise, O Lord, with all my heart; I will make clear all the wonder of your works.

verses.en: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
verses.pt: Em ti me alegrarei e exultarei; cantarei louvores ao teu nome, ó Altíssimo;
verses.en_web: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
verses.en_bbe: I will be glad and have delight in you: I will make a song of praise to your name, O Most High.

verses.en: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.
verses.pt: porquanto os meus inimigos retrocedem, caem e perecem diante de ti.
verses.en_web: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.
verses.en_bbe: When my haters are turned back, they will be broken and overcome before you.

verses.en: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.
verses.pt: Sustentaste o meu direito e a minha causa; tu te assentaste no tribunal, julgando justamente.
verses.en_web: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.
verses.en_bbe: For you gave approval to my right and my cause; you were seated in your high place judging in righteousness.

verses.en: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
verses.pt: Repreendeste as nações, destruíste os ímpios; apagaste o seu nome para sempre e eternamente.
verses.en_web: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.
verses.en_bbe: You have said sharp words to the nations, you have sent destruction on the sinners, you have put an end to their name for ever and ever.

verses.en: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.
verses.pt: Os inimigos consumidos estão; perpétuas são as suas ruínas.
verses.en_web: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.
verses.en_bbe: You have given their towns to destruction; the memory of them has gone; they have become waste for ever.

verses.en: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.
verses.pt: Mas o Senhor está entronizado para sempre; preparou o seu trono para exercer o juízo.
verses.en_web: But Yahweh reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.
verses.en_bbe: But the Lord is King for ever: he has made ready his high seat for judging.

verses.en: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
verses.pt: Ele mesmo julga o mundo com justiça; julga os povos com eqüidade.
verses.en_web: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.
verses.en_bbe: And he will be the judge of the world in righteousness, giving true decisions for the peoples.

verses.en: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
verses.pt: O Senhor é também um alto refúgio para o oprimido, um alto refúgio em tempos de angústia.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will be a high tower for those who are crushed down, a high tower in times of trouble;

verses.en: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
verses.pt: Em ti confiam os que conhecem o teu nome; porque tu, Senhor, não abandonas aqueles que te buscam.
verses.en_web: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.
verses.en_bbe: And those who have knowledge of your name will put their faith in you; because you, Lord, have ever given your help to those who were waiting for you.

verses.en: Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.
verses.pt: Cantai louvores ao Senhor, que habita em Sião; anunciai entre os povos os seus feitos.
verses.en_web: Sing praises to Yahweh, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.
verses.en_bbe: Make songs of praise to the Lord, whose house is in Zion: make his doings clear to the people.

verses.en: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
verses.pt: Pois ele, o vingador do sangue, se lembra deles; não se esquece do clamor dos aflitos.
verses.en_web: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
verses.en_bbe: When he makes search for blood, he has them in his memory: he is not without thought for the cry of the poor.

verses.en: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
verses.pt: Tem misericórdia de mim, Senhor; olha a aflição que sofro daqueles que me odeiam, tu que me levantas das portas da morte.
verses.en_web: Have mercy on me, Yahweh. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death;
verses.en_bbe: Have mercy on me, O Lord, and see how I am troubled by my haters; let me be lifted up from the doors of death;

verses.en: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.pt: para que eu conte todos os teus louvores nas portas da filha de Sião e me alegre na tua salvação.
verses.en_web: that I may show all of your praise. In the gates of the daughter of Zion, I will rejoice in your salvation.
verses.en_bbe: So that I may make clear all your praise in the house of the daughter of Zion: I will be glad because of your salvation.

verses.en: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
verses.pt: Afundaram-se as nações na cova que abriram; na rede que ocultaram ficou preso o seu pé.
verses.en_web: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.
verses.en_bbe: The nations have gone down into the hole which they made: in their secret net is their foot taken.

verses.en: The LORD is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
verses.pt: O Senhor deu-se a conhecer, executou o juízo; enlaçado ficou o ímpio nos seus próprios feitos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord has given knowledge of himself through his judging: the evil-doer is taken in the net which his hands had made. (Higgaion. Selah.)

verses.en: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.
verses.pt: Os ímpios irão para o Seol, sim, todas as nações que se esquecem de Deus.
verses.en_web: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.
verses.en_bbe: The sinners and all the nations who have no memory of God will be turned into the underworld.

verses.en: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.
verses.pt: Pois o necessitado não será esquecido para sempre, nem a esperança dos pobres será frustrada perpetuamente.
verses.en_web: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.
verses.en_bbe: For the poor will not be without help; the hopes of those in need will not be crushed for ever.

verses.en: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
verses.pt: Levanta-te, Senhor! Não prevaleça o homem; sejam julgadas as nações na tua presença!
verses.en_web: Arise, Yahweh! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.
verses.en_bbe: Up! O Lord; let not man overcome you: let the nations be judged before you.

verses.en: Put them in fear, O LORD: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.
verses.pt: Senhor, incute-lhes temor! Que as nações saibam que não passam de meros homens!
verses.en_web: Put them in fear, Yahweh. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: Put them in fear, O Lord, so that the nations may see that they are only men. (Selah.)
